collection.description: A stranger claims a rare flower can cure a deadly illness, but demands nearly all the village's remaining stores in exchange.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A stranger claims a rare flower can cure a deadly illness, but demands nearly all the village's remaining stores in exchange.

choices.label: Buy the remedy with the patient's consent.
Decline the bargain and continue care.
Ask the stranger to demonstrate the remedy

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient recovers, but the village cannot tell whether the flower helped.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The remedy fails, and the depleted stores leave others vulnerable.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The patient recovers slowly with ordinary treatment.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The patient dies, and some villagers blame the decision despite the uncertain claim.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text:
Ask the stranger to demonstrate the remedy without exploiting patients.
The stranger refuses and departs angrily.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text:
Ask the stranger to demonstrate the remedy without exploiting patients.
The stranger admits that the flower only eases pain, and the village negotiates a fair exchange.
